mechanism: Ibuprofen displaces valproic acid from plasma protein binding, increasing free (active) valproic acid levels and toxicity risk; additionally, NSAIDs may inhibit valproic acid metabolism and increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor valproic acid levels and for signs of toxicity (tremor, ataxia, lethargy); consider alternative analgesic (acetaminophen); if NSAID necessary, use lowest effective dose for shortest duration and monitor renal function.
